prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1477; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Rear bumper cover cracked across the left corner, with the left taillight assembly broken and the trunk lid edge scuffed. The damage pattern is mostly consistent with the low-speed impact described. Repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and taillight, refinishing the trunk lid, and checking the rear sensor bracket. The labor hours look a little high for this scope of work, so I recommend a line-by-line review before approval. No earlier damage to this vehicle is known from the records provided, and the invoices show no repeated charges.
